review_candidates.title: Senior IT Application Project Lead Experience in IT project delivery
review_candidates.description: Senior IT Application Project Lead Experience in IT project delivery from 7 to 9 Years The role: (2-3 sentences as explanatory introduction) Reporting to the Manager IT Projects and Applications, the Senior IT Application Project Lead is responsible for leading the delivery of complex IT systems across the high-speed railway organization in Egypt, from requirements definition through to stable go-live. This is a project focused role centered on getting the right systems built, tested, and handed over successfully. You are successful when projects are delivered on time and within scope, stakeholders are aligned throughout, and the systems that go live are stable, well documented, and genuinely fit for purpose. For the right person, the experience and relationships built in this role create a natural foundation for taking on broader application ownership as the organization matures. Your responsibilities: (maximum 10 points) Lead end-to-end delivery of complex IT projects including planning, scoping, risk assessment, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment across business and technology teams. Translate business requirements into structured delivery plans, working closely with business stakeholders to define acceptance criteria, manage scope, and ensure traceability throughout the project lifecycle. Own the change and release framework for project deliveries, ensuring all system changes are introduced in a controlled, compliant, and low-disruption manner. Orchestrate releases end-to-end including impact assessment, deployment runbooks, rollback planning, cutover coordination, and post-release reviews. Direct functional testing and UAT processes, overseeing test strategy, defect triage, readiness sign-off, and user communication and training coordination. Manage environment and configuration integrity across development, test, and production, ensuring non-production environments are fit for purpose throughout the project lifecycle. Coordinate multi-vendor deliveries, keeping external partners accountable to agreed timelines, quality standards, and contractual obligations. Identify, escalate, and manage project risks and issues, maintaining clear and current documentation that gives stakeholders an accurate picture at all times. Lead project governance including steering committee reporting, decision logs, and lessons learned, ensuring each delivery closes cleanly and feeds into continuous improvement. Manage the stabilization and hypercare period following go-live, ensuring delivered systems are fully transitioned and receiving teams are prepared to take ownership. Your profile/ qualifications: (maximum 10 points) Formal education in IT, Computer Science, or a related field is welcome but what matters most is a strong track record of delivering complex IT projects. 6–8 years of experience in IT project delivery, change and release management, or delivery coordination in an enterprise environment. Proven ability to lead multi-vendor, multi-workstream projects with complex dependencies and high stakeholder visibility. Practical knowledge of ITIL change management, release planning, and deployment practices including rollback and hypercare. Hands-on experience with requirements management, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional testing coordination. Experience delivering enterprise applications such as ERP, CMMS, HRIS, or similar SaaS and cloud-hosted systems. Structured and rigorous, with meticulous planning habits and a strong instinct for protecting production stability. A calm and decisive operator, comfortable running governance forums, managing competing priorities, and making clear calls under pressure. Relevant certifications are a plus, particularly PMP, PRINCE2, or ITIL 4 Foundation. Arabic required; strong professional English essential. Comfortable working on site and during off-hours cutovers. This role is about delivering the systems that will run Egypt's first high-speed railway. For someone who combines strong delivery discipline with an interest in how enterprise applications are run and evolved long term, the path forward from here is a meaningful one.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Alameda Healthcare is a regional healthcare network founded in 1999 and led by experienced medical professionals. The group operates four tertiary care hospitals in Cairo, two of which are under construction, and will reach a total capacity of 890 beds when fully commissioned. In addition to its hospitals, Alameda Healthcare manages facilities in Kuwait and London, as well as outpatient clinics, diagnostic centers, specialist centers, pharmacies, and a rehabilitation center. The organization is focused on delivering high-quality, integrated care across its network and advancing healthcare services in the region. Role Description The Digital Transformation Advisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt, responsible for guiding Alameda Healthcare’s digital modernization initiatives across its hospitals and healthcare facilities. The advisor will assess existing clinical and administrative processes, identify opportunities for technology-enabled improvements, and recommend solutions that enhance patient experience, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making. Day-to-day activities include collaborating with hospital leadership and functional teams, mapping workflows, analyzing performance metrics, and developing digital transformation roadmaps. The person in this role will support the implementation of digital tools and platforms, coordinate with external vendors and internal stakeholders, and help ensure change management, training, and adoption across the organization. The advisor will document findings, prepare presentations for executive leadership, and monitor progress against digital strategy objectives. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Digital Transformation and Digital Strategy skills, with experience designing and executing technology-driven change in complex organizations. Candidates should possess robust Analytical Skills, including the ability to interpret data, evaluate processes, and develop actionable insights for performance improvement. Candidates should possess Consulting and Management Consulting skills, with a track record of stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, and solution recommendation. Relevant experience in healthcare, hospital operations, or large-scale service organizations is highly beneficial. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with clinical and non-clinical teams. Experience with project management, change management, and implementation of digital platforms (e.g., EHR, HIS, analytics tools) is an advantage. Ability to work on-site in Cairo, manage multiple initiatives, and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving healthcare environment. End-to-End Digitization: Map out and redesign patient and hospital workflows (booking, registration, consultation, diagnostics, pharmacy, billing, and telehealth) into touchless, digital-first experiences. Product & Journey Enhancement: Scale and optimize the Patient App and Doctor App, connecting them seamlessly with core enterprise systems (EMR, HIS, SAP). Innovation & AI Integration: Identify practical applications for AI, GenAI, conversational AI, and intelligent automation to improve clinical efficiency and patient engagement. Process Automation: Eliminate unnecessary physical touchpoints and administrative friction through workflow automation and self-service solutions. Lifecycle Ownership: Lead digital initiatives from initial concept and process redesign to development, testing, rollout, and post-launch adoption tracking.
